title: Trice Haven Suite Walk To Broadway! Wi-Fi, Pool
description:
This stylish and thoughtfully curated space offers a peaceful haven — just minutes from the city's most iconic attractions.

Trice Haven gives you the best of both worlds: quick access to Nashville’s energy, with the comfort of a calm, relaxing space to come home to.

4 mins →Country Music Hall of Fame
7 mins →Bridgestone+Broadway Strip
10 mins→The Ryman
20 mins →Titans Stadium

10 min drive→Nashville Airport/BNA

Parking: $30 per night

Permit2018071161

The space
Our space provides three spacious queen beds and  easily accommodates 6 guests.

You have access to a private balcony.

There are two smart TVs. Feel free to login into your favorite streaming platforms.

Other amenities:
→ Self check-in
→ Stunning, spacious common workspaces and lux lounges
→ Plush Queen memory foams mattresses that feels AMAZING !

Guest access
Please note, to access the pool, you must list all of your guests’ names for each guest you have in your Airbnb Reservation details. This would be a detail you must update on your end upon making the reservation.

Guests have access to the entire unit and all of the property’s amenities such as lobby, courtyard, sky lounge, swimming pool & gym are included in this rental. 

Please, make yourself at home.

Other things to note
This property operates with Latch smart lock system which we will provide you access upon booking.
